name: 7959-sharegpt-1b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, `--gres=gpu:1`).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one engine process.
load_profile: poisson (OPEN loop), rate = 200 req/s, bounded at 2000 requests with a 900 s safety cap, no warmup. 200/s is far above what this setup sustains, so the arrival stream drains early and the rate that comes out is the server's.
workload: guidellm `json_file` over `configs/data/sharegpt-7959-2000.jsonl`: 2000 single-turn ShareGPT rows, one pass, no shared prefix; prompt lengths mean 226.8 (min 4, max 1021, 453502 total), output lengths mean 202.2 (min 4, max 1835, 404473 total). Responses are STREAMED over the OpenAI-compatible completions API at temperature 0.0.
purpose: A streaming chat assistant on a compact one-billion-parameter model, serving thousands of varied single-turn conversations on one GPU.
launch:
# Serve configuration for one H100 80GB HBM3 of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
#
# 0.6.3-era AsyncEngineArgs: an unknown key is a TypeError at engine construction.
# Do not add flags from a later vLLM.

model: unsloth/Llama-3.2-1B
tensor-parallel-size: 1
num-scheduler-steps: 8
multi-step-stream-outputs: true
max-model-len: 4096
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
